discovery_basis: the exact released brief only; no plan was accessed before this map and discovery were saved
source_id_policy: IDs S1–S21 are immutable within this stage artifact set; do not rebind an ID to another URL. Each entry records exact URL, version/commit or why no fixed release applies, locator, UTC access time, source-observed operation, condition/default/exception, and applicability.

sources.title: IIIF Presentation API 3.0
sources.version_or_commit: 3.0.0; latest stable shown
sources.locator: Canvas, Annotation Page, Annotation, API requests, Authentication
sources.observed_operation: Defines Manifest/Canvas identity, dimensions, referenced image/annotation resources, Canvas fragments, supplementing transcriptions, and authenticated resource flow.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Canvas ID should be HTTPS and persistent; referenced resources must be dereferenceable; clients process according to declared API/context and supported properties; viewer presentation details remain client dependent.
sources.applicability: Primary model for proposed v3 support, Canvas targets, page-level/rectangular notes, remote sources, and explicitly scoped version behavior.

sources.title: IIIF Presentation API 2.1.1
sources.version_or_commit: 2.1.1; previous version to 3.0.0
sources.observed_operation: Specifies v2 Canvas identifiers/dimensions, image links and external annotation-list links; distinguishes image pixels from Canvas coordinates.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Canvas has an HTTP(S) @id, integer width/height, labels; otherContent/AnnotationList is optional; clients require remote resources to be served and may encounter auth/CORS restrictions.
sources.applicability: Basis for accepting legacy collection manifests and mapping their AnnotationList/resource/on structures without rewriting source data.

sources.title: IIIF Presentation API 3.0 Change Log
sources.version_or_commit: 3.0.0 major release; change log dated with the spec
sources.observed_operation: Records adoption of W3C Web Annotation, renaming @id/@type to id/type, and replacing AnnotationList/Layer with AnnotationPage/AnnotationCollection.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: This is a major-version migration with property/class differences; older v2 forms are not a v3 serialization contract.
sources.applicability: Supports version-aware import/export and an explicit compatibility risk for text, target, lists, and layers.

sources.title: W3C Web Annotation Data Model
sources.version_or_commit: W3C Recommendation, 2017-02-23; Web Annotation Data Model 1.0
sources.locator: Textual Body, FragmentSelector, TextQuoteSelector, Specific Resources
sources.observed_operation: Defines embedded text bodies and target selectors; supports multiple selectors to improve later discovery.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: TextualBody should carry value, language/format when relevant; FragmentSelector value follows a media-type fragment syntax; consumer support is not guaranteed for every selector.
sources.applicability: Supports structured transcription/comment bodies and interoperable selector serialization, while requiring viewer-specific verification.

sources.title: W3C Media Fragments URI 1.0 (basic)
sources.version_or_commit: W3C Recommendation, 2012-09-25; Media Fragments URI 1.0 basic
sources.observed_operation: Defines rectangular xywh fragments in pixels or integer percentages relative to source media.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Pixel is default; percent changes x/width relative to image width and y/height relative to image height; rectangles outside bounds are clipped or invalid per the stated cases.
sources.applicability: Supports region-address syntax and scaling discussion; use alongside stored Canvas dimensions and review because media-fragment support varies by client.

sources.title: IIIF Image API 3.0
sources.version_or_commit: 3.0.0 stable specification
sources.locator: Identifier, region, Image Information, CORS, server responses and authentication
sources.observed_operation: Defines remote image service identifiers, region requests including pct coordinates, advertised features, CORS recommendation and HTTP errors/authentication boundaries.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Capabilities depend on the service profile and image-information document; CORS is recommended; auth and access control remain external; 401/403/404/503 have distinct meanings.
sources.applicability: Supports preflight checks for remote image availability and warns that annotation syntax cannot make restricted/unavailable images usable.

sources.title: Image and Canvas with Differing Dimensions
sources.version_or_commit: IIIF Presentation 3.0 cookbook recipe; page accessed at the recorded UTC
sources.observed_operation: Demonstrates a Canvas coordinate space larger than the current image so annotations align after image replacement with different pixel dimensions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Source and Canvas aspect ratios must remain consistent; the recipe’s scale pattern does not address changed crops or content.
sources.applicability: Directly applicable to pilot pages with different image sizes; supports separating durable coordinates from delivered pixels.

sources.title: Simplest Annotation — full Canvas
sources.version_or_commit: IIIF Presentation 3.0 cookbook recipe; page accessed at the recorded UTC
sources.observed_operation: Demonstrates a text annotation targeting a whole Canvas and warns viewers may omit a visual indicator for a whole-Canvas target.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: A whole-page annotation can be valid without a selector but visible markers may vary; a full-area selector may be more widely supported.
sources.applicability: Supports testing whole-page note discovery in each pinned viewer.

sources.title: Transcripts, Captions, and Subtitles — General Considerations
sources.version_or_commit: IIIF Presentation 3.0 cookbook recipe; page accessed at the recorded UTC
sources.observed_operation: Describes download through rendering, one supplementing annotation alongside a resource, and synchronized spatial/temporal fragments.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The mechanism depends on intended user experience; a rendering link is a presentation pointer, not an implemented download UI.
sources.applicability: Evidence for retaining the optional text-only bundle as a separate product choice; does not establish that a viewer already provides the bundle.

sources.title: IIIF Cookbook Viewer Matrix
sources.version_or_commit: Generated current matrix, accessed at the recorded UTC; no fixed release
sources.locator: Annotation Recipes, including Simple Annotation — Tagging
sources.observed_operation: For that recipe the matrix marks Mirador Yes and UV No; it gives per-recipe rather than blanket capability.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Matrix is generated from current cookbook recipes and is subject to correction; Yes/No is limited to that recipe/version and not a full product test.
sources.applicability: Evidence against promising identical annotation behavior in both viewers; informs a recipe-specific pilot matrix.

sources.title: IIIF Viewers
sources.version_or_commit: IIIF project viewer overview, accessed at the recorded UTC
sources.locator: Universal Viewer and Mirador feature descriptions
sources.observed_operation: Describes Universal Viewer as embeddable and broad across IIIF images/audio/video and 3D/PDF; describes Mirador as multi-up and image-comparison capable.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: High-level feature description; it does not establish local integration, authoring, storage, or all annotation features.
sources.applicability: Supports a bounded product comparison by pilot priority, not a claim that either viewer is the full product.

sources.title: Announcing Mirador 4.0
sources.version_or_commit: Mirador 4.0 announced 2025-10-30
sources.observed_operation: Describes React/MUI changes and required plugin/integration/theme updates; calls out community Mirador 4 annotation plugins separately.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Version 4 is a breaking upgrade; plugin availability/compatibility depends on selected plugin and integration.
sources.applicability: Supports pinning viewer/plugin versions and treating annotation authoring as a separate integration decision.

sources.title: mirador-annotations README
sources.version_or_commit: Repository master README viewed 2026-10-10; no release/tag pinned in this source
sources.observed_operation: Provides rectangle/oval/polygon/text-descriptor tools; local-storage demo; states plugin is Mirador 3-only and does not work with Mirador 4; persistent storage requires an annotation server.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Moving branch with no release/version identified on repository page; persistence is not provided by localStorage after browser state loss; server adapters are separately configured.
sources.applicability: Distinguishes Mirador plugin capability from core viewer and proves why v4 authoring support must be selected/tested.

sources.title: Mirador issue #4198 — notification dot missing in M4
sources.version_or_commit: Opened 2025-10-29; closed; issue status shown Done
sources.observed_operation: Records annotation/layer badge visible in M3 but absent in M4 demo and an institutional deployment.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The reported failure concerns discovery badges for canvases with annotations/layers; issue status says closed, not itself proof of release inclusion.
sources.applicability: Concrete regression affecting the act of finding notes during the pilot.

sources.title: Mirador PR #4201 — fix #4198
sources.version_or_commit: Merged 2025-12-04; commit 056262a
sources.observed_operation: Merged a change to provide the required notification-palette tokens for the annotation/layer/search badge.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: A merged fix is distinct from release availability; verify chosen released viewer contains it.
sources.applicability: Links issue history to released viewer testing and a direct regression check.

sources.title: Mirador v4.2.4 release
sources.version_or_commit: v4.2.4, commit 73fafe9; released 2026-09-02 per release page
sources.locator: Release metadata and changed list; includes PR #4201 fix
sources.observed_operation: Identifies an immutable viewer version/commit and the issue-fix release line.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The repo page shows later commits on main after this tag; pinning the release is a reproducible baseline, not a claim that no newer release exists.
sources.applicability: Candidate reproducible Mirador build for a pilot if tested; acceptance should verify page badges and authoring plugin separately.

sources.title: Annotorious with OpenSeadragon and IIIF
sources.version_or_commit: Current official guide; accessed 2026-10-10
sources.observed_operation: Shows loading JSON annotations and connecting Annotorious to OpenSeadragon/IIIF; says coordinates are relative to base image resolution.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Image coordinates are not automatically curator-stable Canvas coordinates; source geometry/dimensions and adapters are integration responsibilities.
sources.applicability: Useful client-side mechanism for a custom image panel, with explicit caveat that persistence and page identity are separate work.

sources.title: Annotorious Annotation Data Model
sources.version_or_commit: Current official guide; accessed 2026-10-10
sources.observed_operation: Describes its optimized native data model and W3CImageFormat crosswalk.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The project explicitly makes no claim to support the full W3C model; conversions need representative selector/body tests.
sources.applicability: Supports evaluating Annotorious as an analogous tool without overstating standards completeness.

sources.title: Visible Text Resource on a Canvas
sources.version_or_commit: IIIF Presentation 3.0 cookbook recipe; page accessed at the recorded UTC
sources.observed_operation: Explains that text painted visibly onto an image uses motivation painting in an AnnotationPage, while commentary/supplementary notes have different semantics; notes client markup restrictions and styling variation.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Painted transcription visibility and viewer support vary; untrusted HTML must be restricted by clients.
sources.applicability: Clarifies why transcription-only download, visible overlay transcription, and private scholar notes are distinct output choices.
